title: Spiral Metal Sculpture
description: A large metallic spiral sculpture embedded in cracked, pebbly concrete ground. The artwork consists of a central brushed silver disc connected to multiple concentric black metal rings forming a large spiral, with a smaller separate spiral formation positioned to the lower right.
prompt: A realistic photograph of a large metallic spiral sculpture embedded in cracked dry concrete ground with small pebbles. The sculpture features a central circular brushed silver metal disc with a small hole in the middle, surrounded by multiple concentric black metal rings forming an expanding spiral pattern. A smaller separate spiral of similar black rings sits disconnected to the lower right of the main piece. The ground is textured with cracks and stones under natural daylight.
